additions.reason: 辟易 has two dictionary senses: しりごみする (shrink back) and 閉口する/うんざりする (be fed up, sick of). The card carries only the first; 自慢話に辟易する — the dominant modern usage — is unreachable from "shrinking back; being baffled". BOTH sides lack it here: ZH 退缩 and 感到为难 give recoil/awkwardness, not 厌烦. Not an English-only gap. Confirmed へきえき is only 辟易, no homophone rival.

てっきり is near-obligatorily counterfactual — the speaker was sure and was wrong (てっきり…と思い込んでいた). "surely; certainly" / 一定,必定 is not merely incomplete, it is misleading: a learner would write 明日はてっきり晴れる. BOTH sides lack the mistaken-belief component; ZH 一定/必定 are plain certainty, so this is not an English-only gap. 満以为 (or 还以为) is the standard Chinese rendering.

労る splits into ①同情する/なぐさめる (pity, console — what the card has) and ②大事にする/手当てする (treat with care, tend to). 体を労る / 老人を労る is sense ②, and "to pity; to console" cannot produce it. BOTH sides lack it: ZH 慰劳 is rewarding someone's effort and 怜悯 is pity; neither is 爱惜/照料. Transitive like the existing glosses (体を労る), so no bad grammar is taught.

誠 splits into ①真実・事実 (truth, reality — what the English line has) and ②誠意・まごころ (sincerity, devotion), as in 誠がこもる / 誠を尽くす. YES — Chinese-already-carries pattern: currentZH 诚实 delivers the sincerity sense, so only the English is short; 诚意 is the precise nominal. One-word addition, high value on an N1 card. Confirmed まこと here is 誠, not the 真/実 "truth" spellings that would belong to a different entry line.

"class, group, category" never reaches the organizational unit, which is 部門's commonest use (営業の部門 = the sales department, not the sales category). Distinct referent, not a rewording. ZH ALREADY CARRIES IT (部门 is the first current gloss and is exact) — this is an English-only gap, the same shape as 23 of the 33 accepted so far, so in practice only glossEN needs to be appended.

The only genuinely separate dictionary sense in the chunk. The EN list ("to close up", "to shut up") covers only 窓を締め切る — shutting something tight; 応募を締め切る (close entries, hit the deadline) is a distinct sense and is absent from English entirely, so a learner reading only EN would misread 応募を締め切る as sealing something shut. Transitivity verified: 締め切る is transitive (…を締め切る), so the gloss teaches correct Japanese. ZH ALREADY CARRIES IT — 截止 is the first current gloss and means precisely this; English-only gap.

素直 has two separate senses: (1) obedient/meek/docile, (2) frank/candid/honest — willing to admit and accept without resistance. The card's English only carries sense 1 ('obedient','meek'), so a learner meeting 自分の失敗を素直に認めて謝った would read it as 'obediently admitted', which is wrong in register and meaning. The Chinese ALREADY carries it (坦率 = frank/candid); this is an English-only gap, matching the pattern of the 23-of-33 accepted cases. Spelling/reading check: すなお is only 素直, no homophone confusion; adjectival noun, no transitivity partner.

審判 splits into an act noun (refereeing, umpiring, judgement) and an agent noun (the referee/umpire himself). The card only has the act: 'refereeing','judgement'. The evidence 審判が笛を吹いて — a person blowing a whistle — cannot be read off 'refereeing'; a learner would parse it as 'the refereeing blew the whistle'. The Chinese ALREADY carries it, since 裁判 in Chinese denotes both the activity and the person, so this is an English-only gap. Reading check: しんぱん is 審判 alone here; no transitivity issue (noun).

refused.why: 驳回。四点理由：(1) 现有英文已经松散覆盖该义——"buried property" 字面就含 "buried"，学习者读到 資源が埋蔵されている 时靠现有 gloss 已能还原"埋在地下"的意思；"burying" 加的是英文词形变体，不是日文新义项。(2) 提案自相矛盾：proposedSense 是 "being buried underground"（被动/状态），给出的 gloss 却是 "burying"（主动动名词，"埋藏的动作"），而证据句是被动的 埋蔵されている——真加进卡片的这个词反而背离了它据以立论的例句。(3) 若说名词表真有缺口，缺的是 "deposit(s); reserves"（埋蔵量＝蕴藏量）这一地质义，而这既不是本次提案的词，本身也仍是名词，撑不起"英文只有名词义"的论证。(4) "缺 vs 义"不是 gloss 层面的问题：サ变名词卡片的名词 gloss 天然支撑 埋蔵する/される，否则每个〜蔵/〜掘类サ变词都要配一条动名词，卡片行为一个卡片结构已编码的词性事实而永久变长。审阅者自己指出中文 埋藏/蕴藏 已"完美传达"、ZH gloss 可略——这恰恰说明该概念已被传达，英文的 "buried" 同样如此。
